reference: A woman was brought to the hospital this morning because she was bleeding heavily, and this had caused her a great deal of distress. model_answer: I’m going to think through the likely causes and urgent hospital steps to stabilize her and stop the bleeding.Heavy vaginal bleeding can be from pregnancy-related problems (miscarriage, ectopic pregnancy) or non-pregnancy causes such as fibroids, polyps, infections, hormonal/anovulatory bleeding, or bleeding disorders.
